pr_title: fix: Fix incorrect column order for parquet scan with hive columns in file
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19992, for both in-memory and new-streaming parquet. The cause of this issue was incorrect schema ordering from projection pushdown.

Also adds a previous fix

* https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/19972

to new-streaming parquet

issue_context.title: Incorrect column order for parquet scan with hive columns included in the file and projection pushdown
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal

tmp_path = Path(".env/_data/")

path = tmp_path / "a=1/b=2/1"
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(
    df := pl.DataFrame(
        {"x": 1, "a": 1, "b": 2, "y": 1},
        schema={"x": pl.Int32, "a": pl.Int8, "b": pl.Int16, "y": pl.Int32},
    )
).write_parquet(path)

assert_frame_equal(
    pl.scan_parquet(tmp_path).select("x", "y", "a", "b").collect(),
    df.select("x", "y", "a", "b"),
)

print("OK")

```


### Log output

```shell
AssertionError: DataFrames are different (columns are not in the same order)
[left]:  ['x', 'a', 'b', 'y']
[right]: ['x', 'y', 'a', 'b']
```


### Issue description

Incorrect column order

### Expected behavior

Correct column order
